# ex: avoid with selector expression (method)
ex {
	import "fmt"
	var x int
	avoid fmt.Println
	x + 1 -> x + 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

import "fmt"

func F() int { return 1 + 1 }
func G() { fmt.Println(1 + 1) }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@

 import "fmt"

-func F() int { return 1 + 1 }
-func G() { fmt.Println(1 + 1) }
+func F() int { return 1 + 2 }
+func G()     { fmt.Println(1 + 2) }
